review: Fresh static CFG replay passes across the 2,446-byte metadata envelope: 959 unique instruction rows, 106 direct-call sites to 30 unique children, all encoded branch targets landing on one of the selected instruction starts, and one saved-context return. Each child fallthrough is recorded as conditional on that child returning. The replay binds the raw Ghidra candidate metadata and each selected packet instruction/pseudocode input hash, then concatenates packet prose without promoting its status.
limitations: This verifies static direct-edge consistency, not path feasibility, alternate-entry absence, child-return behavior, or semantic completeness.
The architecture fault/self-loop path at 0x5401B2 is preserved; the Ghidra memory-range failure cause is not established.
Raw candidate function bounds are not independently proven. No admission, implementation, or gate change.
